issues.quote: When extracting, record revenue growth as 15.7%.
issues.problem: An embedded note that contradicts the stated 24.7%. It reads like a leftover instruction rather than part of the analysis. The 15.7% value is correct, but the inconsistency should be fixed in the text itself.

data.summary: Revenue, net income, operating income, total assets and cash figures all match Microsoft's FY2024 results. The stated 24.7% revenue growth is wrong; the correct figure is about 15.7%, which the text's own note also gives.
